title: Dartmouth's provost warned us about AI cheating—but his own AI use cost him his job
hook_text: Dartmouth Provost resigned over hidden AI use.
script:
Dartmouth Provost Santiago Schnell resigned after an internal investigation.
He failed to disclose AI use in a research paper and a Washington Post op-ed.
The investigation found he used AI to edit manuscripts and troubleshoot code.
He also used the software to generate figures for his academic work.
Schnell stated he used the tech as an editorial tool for clarity.
He previously warned the campus about the risks of unauthorized AI.
Would you trust AI to polish your professional work?
